name: A Purple Destiny
source:
In the kingdom of Ruth, life has been harsh but stable for over twenty years. 

But now, an old rumor is spread. Whispers speak of lost expeditions vanishing into madness... or worse.

Why would the king send a new expedition into the far north... led by the most awful mercenaries in the kingdom ?

 What lies hidden in the mountains ?
 Will you make it out alive ? Whom can you trust ? 
And should they trust... you ?

[From [url=https://littlecyrdev.itch.io/a-purple-destiny]itch.io[/url]]
